name: Ada Pradhaman
subtitle: rice ada simmered in jaggery and thick coconut milk, the sadya finale

ingredients.note: for homemade ada; use 200g shop-bought ada instead if you have it

prepNotes: To make ada: knead the rice flour with boiling water and a pinch of salt into a stiff dough, spread it paper-thin on a greased banana leaf or foil, steam 8 minutes, cool and cut into 1cm squares. Shop-bought dried ada is entirely acceptable.
Soak dried shop-bought ada in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water so it stops sticking to itself.
Melt the jaggery separately in 1/2 cup water and strain it. Jaggery carries grit and you do not want it in the payasam.

steps.text: Boil the ada squares in plenty of water for 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Drain and rinse in cold water.
steps.tip: Rinsing washes off surface starch. Skip it and the payasam turns gluey.

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a heavy pan and fry the cashews until golden, then the raisins until they puff, then the coconut slivers until brown. Lift each out separately.
steps.tip: Cashews burn while you fish out the raisins — do them one at a time.

steps.text: In the same pan pour in the strained jaggery syrup and boil 4 minutes until it thickens and coats a spoon.
Add the drained ada and cook in the syrup on low for 10 minutes, stirring, until each piece is glossy and has darkened to the colour of the jaggery.
steps.tip: This step is what makes ada pradhaman rather than sweetened coconut milk. Do not rush it.

steps.text: Pour in the thin coconut milk and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until it reduces by about a quarter.
Stir in the remaining 2 tbsp ghee and cook 3 minutes more.
Add the powdered cardamom, dry ginger, cumin powder and the pinch of salt.
steps.tip: The salt and dry ginger are not optional flourishes — they are what stop it tasting flatly sweet.

steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the thick coconut milk. Do not return it to the boil.
steps.tip: Boiling after the thick milk goes in will split it. Off the heat, always.

steps.text: Scatter over the fried cashews, raisins and coconut slivers and serve warm.

storage: Keeps 3 days refrigerated and thickens into a pudding. Reheat over low heat with a little extra thin coconut milk; never boil it or the milk will separate.
